neighbours.label: the token ' carbon' as a material/compound stem (carbonate, carbonaceous, carbon fiber)
fire: The reef is built from calcium carbonate laid down by corals over centuries.
Geologists mapped a band of dark carbonaceous mudstone along the ridge.
Her racing bike has a carbon fiber frame and weighs very little.
The quarry exposes thick carbonate beds above the red sandstone.
The lab ground the carbonates and clays into a fine powder.
Engineers wrapped the cracked beam in carbon fibre sheets.
Sodium carbonate is added to soften the wash water.
The meteorite is a rare carbonaceous chondrite found in the desert.
quiet: The reef is built from calcium phosphate laid down by animals over centuries.
Geologists mapped a band of dark bituminous mudstone along the ridge.
Her racing bike has a titanium alloy frame and weighs very little.
The quarry exposes thick limestone beds above the red sandstone.
The lab ground the silicates and clays into a fine powder.
Engineers wrapped the cracked beam in glass fibre sheets.
Sodium chloride is added to soften the wash water.
The meteorite is a rare iron-nickel specimen found in the desert.

notes: Card: ' carbon'/' Carbon' 9 of the top 32, but the top example is 'antu' in Bantu and others are ethnonym pieces (Tsimshian), so this is at best a partial label. Probes: carbonate 0.31, carbon fiber 0.32, carbonaceous 0.20, carbon copy 0.20, carbon dioxide 0.09, Bantu 0.52. The - pole is Catholic/religious-order words.
